modele_veille: question en titre fixe (Cole Gordon, jusqu'à ×11,4)
title: What happens after someone comments GUIDE?

lines.text: You post, people comment GUIDE, and Manychat sends the guide. And then what happens next?
They reply with a real question, like this one.
And that's where most funnels stop, the conversation just sits there.
That's where my shift starts. I wait until they finish typing, then I answer from your offer, in your voice.
One question at a time, and your calendar only goes to the right people.
And when it really matters, I hand the conversation over to you.
Keep your Manychat, add the setter. I'm Ivy, link in bio.
